name: sec-cik-mapper
what_it_holds: Generates and hosts (via GitHub + jsDelivr CDN) daily-updated CSV/JSON mapping files linking SEC CIK <-> ticker <-> company name <-> exchange, plus mutual-fund series/class ID mappings. MIT, 351 commits. NOTE: archived/read-only as of 26 Apr 2025, so mapping files are frozen at that date, not live-updating.
why_useful: Ready-made CIK/ticker crosswalk (ABNB, BKNG, EXPE, MAR, HLT and any peer) to join against XBRL frames / full-text search / financial-statement-dataset pulls without re-deriving CIKs by hand.
duplicate_of_holding: small utility, not a primary dataset
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Ready-made CIK/ticker crosswalk (ABNB, BKNG, EXPE, MAR, HLT and any peer) to join against XBRL frames / full-text search / financial-statement-dataset pulls without re-deriving CIKs by hand.

name: igalci/zacks-scraper
what_it_holds: Small Python package (zacks_scraper/scraper.py) for pulling data from zacks.com; Apache-2.0 licensed; no data files committed, code only.
why_useful: A cleaner, packaged alternative Zacks-pulling method if the team wants to start a forward point-in-time Zacks consensus capture for ABNB/BKNG/EXPE; would need to be run going forward, contributes nothing retroactive.
themes: Analyst estimates and consensus history: Yahoo/Zacks/Finviz/Estimize/Alpha Vantage scrapers, historical EPS estimate datasets, estimate-revision datasets, I/B/E/S-like open data
why_all: A cleaner, packaged alternative Zacks-pulling method if the team wants to start a forward point-in-time Zacks consensus capture for ABNB/BKNG/EXPE; would need to be run going forward, contributes nothing retroactive.

name: DerekZhang0000/ZackScraper
what_it_holds: Node.js scraper compiling Zacks' "top recommended stocks" rank changes; a stock-screener/rating scraper, not an EPS-estimate history extractor.
why_useful: Marginal: Zacks Rank changes are a coarse revision-direction signal, not usable for ABNB EPS estimate history directly, but shows a working scrape pattern against Zacks pages if the team wants ABNB-specific rank tracking going forward.
themes: Analyst estimates and consensus history: Yahoo/Zacks/Finviz/Estimize/Alpha Vantage scrapers, historical EPS estimate datasets, estimate-revision datasets, I/B/E/S-like open data
why_all: Marginal: Zacks Rank changes are a coarse revision-direction signal, not usable for ABNB EPS estimate history directly, but shows a working scrape pattern against Zacks pages if the team wants ABNB-specific rank tracking going forward.

name: bvb-06/WebScraping-Estimize

name: ner-aim/Retreving-Financial-Estimates-using-Estimize

why_useful: Low direct relevance (predates ABNB's public listing) but shows another Estimize-pulling method; mainly useful as a code pattern.
